how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for A&N PMB Pilot Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the A&N PMB Pilot Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the A&N PMB Pilot Officer recruitment is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Pilot Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Pilot Officer post in the Andaman & Nicobar Port Management Board recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Pilot Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Pilot Officer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 2,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the A&N PMB Pilot Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Pilot Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Pilot Officer role primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this A&N PMB recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Pilot Officer position is on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Pilot Officer position is in Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Andaman & Nicobar Port Management Board recruitment is 5-155/PMB/PL/2020/3476.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.
